title: GPT Image can edit existing images
summary:
GPT Image gained editing support and more quality choices, with requests now following the same image queue.

The gptimage integration now supports image editing when a request includes an image, while requests without one continue to generate new images. Image inputs can be URLs, file paths, base64 data, or buffers.

Image requests now accept low, medium, high, or hd quality. Invalid values fall back to medium.

Valid tokens no longer bypass the image queue for gptimage requests.

highlights.title: Edit with GPT Image
highlights.text: Provide an image with your `gptimage` request to edit it, or leave it out to generate a new one. Image inputs support URLs, file paths, base64 data, and buffers. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
